title: CL formatting rules
description: Formatting rules for Honeywell CL sources in this folder and below. The nearest .clformat.json above a file applies. Anything not set here is learned from the file being formatted.

columns.description: Column (0 = first) where each kind of line starts. A kind not given keeps the column the file uses most for it.

unit.description: SEQUENCE, SUBROUTINE, handler, BLOCK and PACKAGE headings.

label.description: Statements with a label: where the label starts.

else.description: ELSE lines. Defaults to the statement column.

trimTrailingSpaces.description: Remove spaces at the ends of lines.

uppercaseKeywords.description: Write keywords such as SET, IF and THEN in capitals. Names are left as written.

maxLineLength.description: Re-indenting never takes a line past this column. The compiler reads 132.
